name: NEO-TETRIS (Modernizing A Classic) (Mae by : Saif Ali Khan (Solo))
author: Xaif
description: NEO-TETRIS is a game I made for Create with Code Game Jam. As per theme (Modernizing a Classic) I decided to modernize Tetris with hyper casual feel. As the name suggests the game takes inspiration from neon /sci-fi assets. A lot of creators have made Tetris in unity before so programming wasn't a very big challenge. I thoroughly enjoyed the whole game jamming process. First I wrote down my idea, then divided it into sub-tasks. After division I prioritized them. First came basic functionality like creation of grid, making prefabs and then spawning. After these tasks I worked on some post processing to get the feel in game so that I would enjoy creating it more. After then I worked on basic UI and tried to polish it a little by optimizing code and adding sounds. I used Neon sphere's asset for level design. Used Camera Shake by watching videos of Brackey's. Also used Sci-fi sound effects assets from Asset store.
